summary: Borr Drilling filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) on 2026-11-02 carrying a press release updating the Prospector 5 rig incident offshore Gabon first disclosed 2026-10-25. The body of a fourth individual has been recovered; search continues for one person unaccounted for. Borr has engaged a globally recognized classification society to run an independent root-cause investigation, with all potential causes of catastrophic loss of stability in scope, and will cooperate with authorities. No transaction terms; operational and litigation risk is the watch item.
